messages:
Aisha: Customer reported Dedicated console shows 0 GPUs in eu-west-2-prod-gpu after we rolled back node labels last night. API /dedicated/inventory returns nodes but GPUs count 0. ticket #CS-4871

Mateo: Can you paste the ticket + cluster name? I'll query k8s and Prom.

Aisha: cluster=eu-west-2-prod-gpu, ticket=CS-4871. Customer says nodes are Ready. They started seeing 0 GPUs around 02:10 UTC.

Jun: quick checks:
- kubectl get nodes -l dedicated=redwood,gpu=true -o wide
- kubectl get pods -n monitoring -l app=prometheus

Aisha: ran locally, output:
```
$ kubectl get nodes -l dedicated=redwood,gpu=true --no-headers | wc -l
0
$ kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.labels}' | grep gpu -n || true
# shows last label set as gpu=false on most nodes after rollback
```

Mateo: ah ok — rollback flipped gpu label to false. Console's inventory queries labels to attribute GPUs. Prom scraping still sees nvidia_smi metrics from nodes?

Jun: checked prometheus targets, node-exporter shows up for the nodes but the gpu exporter metric name changed because our label selector was gpu=true. scrape shows nvidia_gpu_count{node="ip-..."} = 8 for each node when metric queried directly, but our aggregation query used label filter `gpu="true"` so it returned 0.

Lily (support): customer impact = Dedicated dashboard shows 0 available GPUs, alerts triggered. CS escalated to enterprise SLA. They've attached logs and timestamps.

Mateo: reproduction steps for infra team:
1) rollback labels: `kubectl label nodes <node> gpu=false --overwrite`
2) confirm prometheus query: `sum(nvidia_gpu_count)` vs `sum(nvidia_gpu_count{gpu="true"})`

Jun: mitigation options:
- Reapply gpu=true label to nodes (fast, but we need to verify why rollback happened)
- Make console inventory use metric-based fallback when label-based query returns 0

Aisha: I'll reapply labels on a single node and test before customer-facing change.

Mateo: I'll open an infra PR to adjust console query to fall back to `sum(nvidia_gpu_count)` when label filter yields zero for a cluster for >5m.

Jun: also adding alert to detect label flips that reduce labeled gpu node count >50%.

Lily (support): customer notified we'll do a rolling relabel and change in queries. ETA 30m. CS will hold off on further escalations.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-119 — Dedicated inventory mismatch in eu-west-2-prod-gpu — assignees: Mateo, Jun, Aisha

Aisha: reapply test done on one node, console shows 8 GPUs for that node now. Rolling relabeling in progress. I'll post updates.

Mateo: thanks — adding notes to the rollback automation to not toggle gpu label. :thumbsup:

Jun: follow-up: need postmortem once incident is closed, include timeline and prevention (query fallback and label protection).
